description:
Cast Clone by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Clone into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Clone dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Clone enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Clone leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Clone from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.
